d.ko: 이 비행 어드벤처 플랫폼 게임에서 활기 넘치는 픽셀 월드를 탐험해 보세요.
d.en:
Owlboy is a story-driven platform adventure game, where you can fly and explore a brand new world in the clouds! 

Pick up your friends, and bring them with you as you explore the open skies, in one of the most detailed adventures of this era.
d.zh: Owlboy 是一款剧情驱动型跳台冒险游戏。其中，你可以飞去探索云端的全新世界！邀上好友三五人，带他们一起去探索开放的天空。
